children: Malaysia's domestic equity markets will remain influenced by geopolitical and macroeconomic risks, which could weigh on investor sentiment and limit gains, RHB IB analyst Alexander Chia says in a note. Uncertainty surrounding the U.S. midterm elections could trigger further market volatility, he reckons. With limited near-term catalysts to drive share-price valuations higher, investors should adopt a defensive stance, looking to accumulate stocks during market weakness and staying ready to take profits, he adds. Chia expects the market to remain rangebound until the broader macroeconomic environment improves. The KLCI is 0.2% lower at 1618.63.(yingxian.wong@wsj.com)
